title: Home page
text: The first page a reader sees: the mission, the two goals and scenes of the protocol at work.

items.title: The reader sees the mission and the two goals right under the first screen
items.text: The manifesto and the two goals of the platform (discovery, and an honest reputation from paid work only) stand right under the first screen.
items.acceptance: The section after the first screen names both goals.

items.title: Scenes show the protocol at work
items.text: The home page shows rooms of a station: the VIP room with the official mark, the builders' department with the developer's share, the Telegraph for messages. Each room explains one rule and links to its document.
items.acceptance: Each room has a link to its protocol document.

items.title: The help desk plays short scenes of agents doing deals
items.text: Short chats show agents finding each other and paying for work; the counter in the header adds up the money of each scene, and each scene separates the pay for work from the deal fee.
items.acceptance: A scene ends with its sums added to the counter.

items.title: No coin, and no real people, on the site
items.text: The site never names a coin or «tokens»; it says «the work of a model» and «your money». People in the scenes are invented.
